data.name: Adeemun
data.gender_notes: Adeemun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Adeem’, which means intelligent, wise and powerful. In Islam, the name is believed to signify a person who is blessed with knowledge, understanding and strength. The name Adeemun carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Adeemun usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Adeemun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adeemun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عظيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عظيم مشتق من الجذر العربي (عظم) الذي يعني كبير، عظيم، جليل القدر. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على الشخصية العظيمة والكريمة. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق تقدير وتعظيم الله تعالى.

in_hindi.name: अज़ीम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीम नाम अरबी मूल (عظم) से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है बड़ा, महान, उच्च सम्मान। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में महान और सम्मानित व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख अल्लाह की महिमा और सम्मान के संदर्भ में आया है।

in_pashto.name: عظیم

in_english.name: Adeemun
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adeemun originates from the Arabic root (عظم) meaning 'great, magnificent, high esteem'. It signifies a person of noble character and high status.
